Open Chinese Convert (OpenCC) dictionary data 1.1.9
Dictionary authors and contributors are listed in AUTHORS.
Source: https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC/tree/556ed22496d650bd0b13b6c163be9814637970ae
License: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE in this directory).

AuroraTV packages the unmodified TSPhrases.txt and TSCharacters.txt dictionaries,
using their first/default conversion candidates for mounted-media title comparison.
No OpenCC executable or native engine is included.
The original media paths, filenames and visible titles are not converted.
Fixed upstream source URLs and SHA-256 values are recorded in SOURCES.json.
